title: Backyard BBQ
description: A 3-minute 58-second radio play set around a backyard barbecue in Ontario. Through dialogue, environmental sound, and detailed cooking cues, the work turns a casual gathering into a small portrait of friendship, food, and cultural coexistence.

title: An Eventful Weekend
description: A narrative audio piece following an unpredictable weekend through apartments, nightlife, bus rides, streets, and conversations with friends. Field recordings and dialogue transform everyday moments into a gradually more unexpected journey.

title: Drumbeat
description: An experimental electronic composition built around a repeating rhythmic pulse. Created with VCV Rack and Reaper, the piece layers sequenced rhythms, synthesized tones, filters, modulation, and spatial movement into an evolving soundscape.

title: Fungal Hallucination
description: An immersive sound work following a hallucination after eating mushrooms. Human voice, wind, birds, water, alarms, silence, and synthesized sound gradually blur the boundary between the natural environment, altered perception, and imagined reality.

title: Frozen Memory Fragments
description: An experimental sound piece reflecting on change, memory, and the difficulty of leaving the past behind. Moving through images of trains, windows, silence, pulses, and melting ice, the work treats memory as something temporarily frozen, fragmented, yet still alive beneath the surface.
